rows.notes: Fill pass T035. Installed 4 GWh/yr as of 2025-12-01 is a PROJECT-LEVEL inference, not a stated installed figure: the 4 GWh/yr LFP ESS cell project had all equipment (> RMB 600m) installed and was in material commissioning by 2024-05-21 (S2), and Xinhua photographed LFP storage cells made at Jiuquan Narada on 2025-12-01 (S3), so the project's lines are taken as commissioned and producing. installed basis: company (project design capacity, via press). No source gives a Jiuquan-specific installed GWh; the 2025 annual report gives only the company-wide cell capacity of 10 GWh (S1), which cannot be split by site (T023 arithmetic leaves ~3 GWh unattributed). Lead: if the audit treats installed=project nameplate as unsupported, null installed_capacity_gwh and installed_as_of. Unchanged from T022: status operational, nameplate 4 GWh, ref_year 2024 (fallback: design commissioning H1 2024), start_year null (18 Jun 2024 launch ceremony page desn.com.cn not re-fetchable), chemistry LFP, end_market ESS, v1 cell_format/announced_year still reported (not re-confirmed). Note the SMM headline says 2.4 GWh while its body says 4GWh; body and the company's 2023 project name (annual 4 GWh) agree on 4.
